title: Switch Pacman branch
summary: Change your system's package branch to stable, testing, or unstable. This is an advanced action that changes which version of packages you receive.

steps.explain: Switch to a different branch (stable, unstable, or testing). This requires administrator rights and will change your package sources.

placeholders.name: BRANCH
placeholders.description: The branch to switch to: stable, unstable, or testing.

rollback.explain: Switch back to the previous branch using the same command with the original branch name.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_BRANCH
placeholders.description: The branch you were on before switching.

warnings: Switching branches can lead to system instability if you are not familiar with the process. Ensure you understand the implications of moving between stable, testing, and unstable.
After switching, you must synchronize your database and update your system using 'sudo pacman -Syyu'.
